DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_date'[Year-Month],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Revenue__BRL_", '_Measures'[Revenue (BRL)],
			"Orders", IGNORE('_Measures'[Orders])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'dim_date'[Year-Month], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'dim_date'[Year-Month]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

	VAR __ValueFilterDM0 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					'dim_customer'[state],
					__DS0FilterTable,
					"Customer_OTD__", '_Measures'[Customer OTD %],
					"Orders", IGNORE('_Measures'[Orders])
				)
			),
			[Orders] >= 500
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_customer'[state],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__ValueFilterDM0,
			"Customer_OTD__", '_Measures'[Customer OTD %]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, [Customer_OTD__], 1, 'dim_customer'[state], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[Customer_OTD__], 'dim_customer'[state]

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

	VAR __ValueFilterDM0 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					'dim_seller'[seller_id],
					__DS0FilterTable,
					"Supplier_OTD__", '_Measures'[Supplier OTD %],
					"Supplier_Complaint_Rate__", '_Measures'[Supplier Complaint Rate %],
					"Revenue__BRL_", '_Measures'[Revenue (BRL)],
					"MinABC_Segment", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('dim_seller'[ABC Segment]))),
					"Is_Critical_Supplier", IGNORE('_Measures'[Is Critical Supplier]),
					"Is_Relevant_Supplier", IGNORE('_Measures'[Is Relevant Supplier])
				)
			),
			[Is_Relevant_Supplier] = 1
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_seller'[seller_id],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__ValueFilterDM0,
			"Supplier_OTD__", '_Measures'[Supplier OTD %],
			"Supplier_Complaint_Rate__", '_Measures'[Supplier Complaint Rate %],
			"Revenue__BRL_", '_Measures'[Revenue (BRL)],
			"MinABC_Segment", IGNORE(CALCULATE(MIN('dim_seller'[ABC Segment]))),
			"Is_Critical_Supplier", IGNORE('_Measures'[Is Critical Supplier])
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample = 
		SAMPLECARTESIANPOINTSBYCOVER(3500, __DS0Core, [Supplier_OTD__], [Supplier_Complaint_Rate__])

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample

ORDER BY
	'dim_seller'[seller_id]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

	VAR __ValueFilterDM1 = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
					'dim_seller'[seller_id],
					'dim_seller'[state],
					'dim_seller'[ABC Segment],
					__DS0FilterTable,
					"Revenue__BRL_", '_Measures'[Revenue (BRL)],
					"Supplier_OTD__", '_Measures'[Supplier OTD %],
					"Supplier_Complaint_Rate__", '_Measures'[Supplier Complaint Rate %],
					"Avg_Seller_Processing__days_", '_Measures'[Avg Seller Processing (days)],
					"Order_Items", '_Measures'[Order Items],
					"OTD_Status", IGNORE('_Measures'[OTD Status]),
					"Is_Relevant_Supplier", IGNORE('_Measures'[Is Relevant Supplier])
				)
			),
			[Is_Relevant_Supplier] = 1
		)

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				ROLLUPGROUP('dim_seller'[seller_id], 'dim_seller'[state], 'dim_seller'[ABC Segment]), "IsGrandTotalRowTotal"
			),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			__ValueFilterDM1,
			"Revenue__BRL_", '_Measures'[Revenue (BRL)],
			"Supplier_OTD__", '_Measures'[Supplier OTD %],
			"Supplier_Complaint_Rate__", '_Measures'[Supplier Complaint Rate %],
			"Avg_Seller_Processing__days_", '_Measures'[Avg Seller Processing (days)],
			"Order_Items", '_Measures'[Order Items],
			"OTD_Status", IGNORE('_Measures'[OTD Status])
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(
			502,
			__DS0Core,
			[IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			0,
			[Revenue__BRL_],
			0,
			'dim_seller'[seller_id],
			1,
			'dim_seller'[state],
			1,
			'dim_seller'[ABC Segment],
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals = 
		FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0Core), [IsGrandTotalRowTotal] = FALSE)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0CoreNoInstanceFiltersNoTotals,
		"MinRevenue__BRL_", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Revenue__BRL_]),
		"MaxRevenue__BRL_", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Revenue__BRL_])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[Revenue__BRL_] DESC,
	'dim_seller'[seller_id],
	'dim_seller'[state],
	'dim_seller'[ABC Segment]

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited =

		"Revenue__BRL_", IGNORE('_Measures'[Revenue (BRL)]),
		"Supplier_OTD__", IGNORE('_Measures'[Supplier OTD %]),
		"Late_Handovers", IGNORE('_Measures'[Late Handovers]),
		"Avg_Seller_Processing__days_", IGNORE('_Measures'[Avg Seller Processing (days)]),
		"Supplier_Complaint_Rate__", IGNORE('_Measures'[Supplier Complaint Rate %])

DEFINE
	VAR __SQDS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

	VAR __SQDS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'dim_seller'[seller_id],
			__SQDS0FilterTable,
			"Late_Handovers", '_Measures'[Late Handovers]
		)

	VAR __SQDS0BodyLimited = 
		TOPN(50, __SQDS0Core, [Late_Handovers], 0)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({"7c67e1448b00f6e969d365cea6b010ab"}, 'dim_seller'[seller_id])

	VAR __DS0FilterTable2 = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__SQDS0BodyLimited,
		__DS0FilterTable,
		__DS0FilterTable2,
		"Selected_Supplier_Title", IGNORE('_Measures'[Selected Supplier Title])
	)

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({TRUE}, 'dim_date'[Is Analysis Period])

	VAR __DS0CoreNoInstanceFilters = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			ROLLUPADDISSUBTOTAL(
				'dim_customer'[state], "IsGrandTotalRowTotal",
				'dim_date'[Year-Month], "IsDM1Total"
			),
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Late_Orders", '_Measures'[Late Orders]
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreWithInstanceFilters = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0CoreNoInstanceFilters),
			OR(
				OR([IsGrandTotalRowTotal], AND(NOT([IsGrandTotalRowTotal]), [IsDM1Total])),
				AND(NOT([IsDM1Total]), 'dim_customer'[state] IN {"SP"})
			)
		)

	VAR __ScopedAggregateReferenceTableDM3WithInstanceFilters = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0CoreWithInstanceFilters),
			AND(NOT([IsGrandTotalRowTotal]), NOT([IsDM1Total]))
		)

	VAR __ScopedAggregatesForDS0ByDM1 = 
		ADDCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(
				GROUPBY(
					__ScopedAggregateReferenceTableDM3WithInstanceFilters,
					'dim_customer'[state],
					"A4", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Late_Orders]),
					"A5", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Late_Orders])
				)
			),
			"IsGrandTotalRowTotal", FALSE,
			"IsDM1Total", TRUE
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithScopedAggregates = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0CoreWithInstanceFilters,
			__ScopedAggregatesForDS0ByDM1
		)

	VAR __DS0CoreTableByDM1 = 
		SELECTCOLUMNS(
			KEEPFILTERS(FILTER(KEEPFILTERS(__DS0PrimaryWithScopedAggregates), [IsDM1Total] = TRUE)),
			"IsGrandTotalRowTotal", [IsGrandTotalRowTotal],
			"'dim_customer'[state]", 'dim_customer'[state],
			"SortBy_DM1_0", [Late_Orders]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWithScopedAggregates,
			__DS0CoreTableByDM1
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyTopNPerLevel = 
		TOPNPERLEVEL(
			14,
			__DS0PrimaryWithSortColumns,
			{(0, "[IsGrandTotalRowTotal]", "", 1),
				(1, "[IsDM1Total]", "[SortBy_DM1_0]", 0),
				(1, "[IsDM1Total]", "'dim_customer'[state]", 1),
				(2, "", "[Late_Orders]", 0),
				(2, "", "'dim_date'[Year-Month]", 1)},
			{(0, 1, "'dim_customer'[state]", "SP")},
			{},
			"RestartIndicator"
		)

	VAR __ScopedAggregateReferenceTableDM1WithInstanceFilters = 
		FILTER(
			KEEPFILTERS(__DS0CoreWithInstanceFilters),
			AND(NOT([IsGrandTotalRowTotal]), [IsDM1Total])
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__ScopedAggregateReferenceTableDM1WithInstanceFilters,
		"MinLate_Orders", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Late_Orders]),
		"MaxLate_Orders", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Late_Orders])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyTopNPerLevel

ORDER BY
	[IsGrandTotalRowTotal] DESC,
	[SortBy_DM1_0] DESC,
	'dim_customer'[state],
	[IsDM1Total] DESC,
	[Late_Orders] DESC,
	'dim_date'[Year-Month]
